name: Kurose Jouji
source:
High school boyfriend and later husband of [url=https://vndb.org/c95609]Hinako[/url] after accidentally impregnating her.

He has cheated on Hinako multiple times and spends most of his free time messing around with other women. He has made zero attempt to provide for his family, despite repeatedly promising Hinako he would get a job.
